calculate_elastic_tensor: calculate the elastic tensor for an ASE Atoms object using a calculator and strain values
compute_bulk_modulus: compute the bulk modulus VRH for a crystal structure using the calculate_elasticity function
compute_shear_modulus: compute the shear modulus VRH for a crystal structure using the calculate_elasticity function
relax_initial_structure: relax the initial atomic structure before computing elasticity using the relax_initial parameter
run_elasticity_with_custom_strains: run elasticity calculations with custom normal and shear strain sequences on an Atoms object
